Class UserService

java.lang.Object
lms.application.UserService
public class UserService extends Object
Application service for managing users in the Library Management System.

This service coordinates user-related operations including retrieval, updates, registration, and deletion. It enforces authorization rules and returns data as UserDTO objects to maintain proper layer separation.

Key responsibilities:

  • Retrieve users by username or list all users
  • Update user information with authorization checks
  • Register new users with hashed passwords
  • Check borrowing eligibility

    • updateUser

      public boolean updateUser(UserDTO currentUser, UUID userID, String newUsername, String newEmail, String newPassword, Role newRole) throws IllegalAccessException, UserNotFoundException
      Updates user information with authorization checks.

      Only admins or the user themselves can update their information. Username cannot be changed after creation.

      Parameters:
      currentUser - the currently authenticated user
      userID - the ID of the user to update
      newUsername - must be null (username changes not allowed)
      newEmail - the new email (null to keep unchanged)
      newPassword - the new password (null to keep unchanged)
      newRole - the new role (null to keep unchanged)
      Returns:
      true if update succeeded
      Throws:
      IllegalAccessException - if user lacks permission to update
      UserNotFoundException - if the target user doesn't exist
      IllegalArgumentException - if attempting to change username

    • registerUser

      public UserDTO registerUser(String username, String rawPassword, String firstName, String lastName, String email, Role role)
      Registers a new user in the system.
      Parameters:
      username - the username (must be unique)
      rawPassword - the plain text password (will be hashed)
      firstName - the user's first name
      lastName - the user's last name
      email - the user's email address
      role - the user's role
      Returns:
      the newly created user as a DTO
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if username already exists
      IllegalStateException - if registration fails
